title: Partner Portal 1.2.0
summary: Language icon, a larger ticket window and a shorter Support page.

items.title: Language icon
items.body: The top bar has a language icon: English, Italiano, Português and Español. The choice applies at once and is remembered for your user.

items.title: Ticket window
items.body: A ticket opens in a large window over the page. It explains how the support works: assisted by Nexwall AI trained on the knowledge base, the documentation and the firewall behaviour, with specialists behind it, and escalation when needed.

items.title: Escalate to L2 · Advanced CLI troubleshooting
items.body: The ticket window has a button that opens the Cloud Controller on the ticket's firewall, where the second level runs Support Packets and advanced CLI diagnostics.

items.title: Conversation opens at the newest message
items.body: When a ticket opens, or a message arrives, the conversation scrolls to the last message.

items.title: Shorter Support page text
items.body: The page now says in two lines how the three support levels work and that everything stays in the same ticket.
